summary: Patrol crow's nest on Murray Peak, Shoshone County, Idaho, first listed in 1939; sources date abandonment to 1942 or 1947 and describe nothing left at the site.

facts.design: Patrol crow's nest atop Murray Peak
facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists the site as Crowsnest, Abandoned

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site Hike-In

events.note: Listed as a patrol crow's nest; the sources give no separate build date
Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date abandonment to 1942; the Shoshone County list says 1947

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists this site as Crowsnest, Abandoned. The index gives Tower Gone for the other two sites in this batch, and no source says this crow's nest is gone.
The index lists the type as Crowsnest, and firelookout.com describes a patrol crow's nest, not a platform.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say 1942; the Shoshone County list says 1947. Not resolved; the story gives both dates.

notes_for_editor: Story is about 133 words. The 1939 entry places the crow's nest on Murray Peak, 1.25 miles northwest; the FFLOS coordinates may mark Murray Peak rather than Horseshoe Peak. Not resolved, so the story does not say which spot the coordinates mark. The brief status gone conflicts with the index's Abandoned; the correction is proposed for editor review. Idaho Historical Aerial Photographs item A1152 (1935) lists Murray Peak as a feature; its rights notice restricts reproduction and its record does not mention a lookout, so no photo is added.
